reviews.text: Empathetic and professional service. We received good care from them throughout our dog's entire 14-year life span. Beautiful memories remained. Thank you.

We used to be regular customers, but the last few visits left a lingering feeling. After the reception, it was impossible to get clarification on the treatment instructions given in a hurry. Instead, we were redirected to the reception, which left a taste of fraud. We moved to Jätkäsaari and the level of service increased dramatically.

I highly recommend it. My dog ​​has been treated with all the tenderness and love here. The owner has also been treated kindly and everything has been explained clearly and understandably, as there has been concern for the pet's well-being. I have always received an appointment quickly and the prices are reasonable, so it has been a pleasure to support a private entrepreneur.

Unfortunately, based on our experience, I cannot recommend this place. I went to have my dog's split nail removed here. The next day, I noticed that the nail was severely inflamed and pus-filled. It turned out that a large piece of nail had not been removed in the nail bed. We had to take the dog to the emergency room on a Sunday, where the remaining part of the nail was removed. This was a clear medical error, as the nail should have been removed completely to prevent infection.

I filed a complaint about the situation. The clinic denied making a mistake, although according to another veterinarian it was a clear medical error. As a result, the dog had to be sedated twice, suffered clearly from pain and received a long course of antibiotics and painkillers.

A medical error in a routine procedure, evasion of responsibility and unwillingness to admit a mistake gave a rather unreliable picture of the operation.
Always good care and friendly approach to our dogs. Thank you!
There's starting to be too much of a taste for funding in the business, I'll go elsewhere with my money.
Empathetic and really nice service! It was a pleasure to visit with the puppy.
